solar_potential_by_postal_code: Holds solar potential aggregated at the postal-code-level; grain = one row per postal code region (region_name) with geographic bounds (lat_max, lat_min, lng_max, lng_min, lat_avg, lng_avg, center_point) and key measures including yearly_sunlight_kwh_* (n/s/e/w/f/median/total), yearly_sunlight_kwh_kw_threshold_avg, number_of_panels_* (n/s/e/w/f/median/total), kw_median, kw_total, install_size_kw_buckets, count_qualified, percent_covered, percent_qualified, carbon_offset_metric_tons, existing_installs_count, and identifiers region_name and state_name.
solar_potential_by_censustract: Holds solar potential aggregated at the census-tract-level; grain = one row per census tract region (region_name) with geographic bounds (lat_max, lat_min, lng_max, lng_min, lat_avg, lng_avg, center_point) and key measures including yearly_sunlight_kwh_* (n/s/e/w/f/median/total), yearly_sunlight_kwh_kw_threshold_avg, number_of_panels_* (n/s/e/w/f/median/total), kw_median, kw_total, install_size_kw_buckets, count_qualified, percent_covered, percent_qualified, carbon_offset_metric_tons, existing_installs_count, and identifiers region_name and state_name.
